gate_claims.claim: When a regression investigation asks for a reproduction, the triage and root-cause stages also write testbench files and a before-review gate runs simulator.run with expect=fail over the approved RTL under investigation and one testbench at a time, its top taken from that testbench
the reproduction gate is declared by REPRODUCES with each=True, entry=True, expect=fail and before_review
the reproducing() refinement adds the testbench output to a stage when a reproduction is asked for
the triage stage is gated by REPRODUCES and needs a veritriage.investigate session
the root-cause stage names one of four outcomes: rtl_bug, testbench_bug, infrastructure, spec_ambiguity (RTL bug, testbench bug, infrastructure, specification question)
the root-cause stage is gated by REVIEWED and REPRODUCES
a decision seat must name one of the four outcomes
expect is restricted to pass (the default) or fail; any other value is refused before anything runs
expect restriction in the gate code
with expect=fail the run passes only when the build succeeded, $finish was reached and exactly one verdict line with this run's nonce reports at least one failed check
a testbench whose checks all pass, one that prints no verdict or two, and one that does not build all fail the reproduction gate
the verdict line format NIRMAAN-SIM <nonce> <n> passed, <m> failed
only the file that declares the top module may end the run, read plusargs or open files; a design file that does is refused before anything is simulated (code)
a design that ends the simulation fails the reference testbench
a design cannot read the nonce
a repro that passes on the RTL under investigation stops the work before review
in an evaluation the must-fail scorer runs the repro on the clean inputs (must pass) and on each mutant (must fail)
must-fail scorer contract in code
veritriage.investigate reports a classification with a confidence and a top hypothesis
card: single-hypothesis tunnel vision is the root_cause_analysis failure mode
card: the conclusion names its evidence and the alternatives it rejects
